shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'; rg --files src | sort | head -100; printf '\\n--- orchestrator tests/source ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|VALIDATED_BY|tests.list|test name|testName|describe\\(\" scripts .lore src -g '*.mjs' -g '*.yml' -g '*.ts' | head -150; cat package.json; cat jest.config.js; sed -n '1,80p' specs/hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md; git status --short --branch; git log -5 --oneline --decorate"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; rg -n \"descriptor|spec field|@spec|spec anchor|specs/\" .lore scripts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; sed -n '29,45p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git diff --check; git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test: define beforeSession failure hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
